title: Brutal Red & Black 100ml Shortfill By Just Juice
description: Red & Black from Brutal is a distinctly delicious trip back through time to those addictive red and black gummies we used to devour in our youth. Just like you could never stop at just a few of those squishy little pebbles of raspberry and blackcurrant flavour chews, so it is with this irresistibly nostalgic Red & Black e-liquid from Brutal. Relive that sweet berry candy flavour with every puff of this magical juice! This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite e-liquid goes the distance and comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot or two to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks. Brutal E-liquid is a brand new range of long-lasting 100ml shortfills from UK e-juice masters Just Juice. Each Brutal vape flavour has been designed to whisk you away to wistful days gone by when a visit to the tuck shop was the highlight of every child’s day! If you love Red & Black from Brutal, why not treat yourself to other mouth-watering sweetshop classics in the collection? Brutal e-liquid flavours feature five nostalgic favourites, such as Rhubarb and Custard, Mr Jack’s liquorice and aniseed, Sour Strawberry Bubblegum and Raspberry Sour chew bars. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly.
